title: Pruning preserves every infinite word; boundary repair preserves avoidance
programme: Infinite populations · pruning and eligibility repair

plain_language.question: Which deletions preserve infinite target languages, and when can a retained population be made eligible without adding edges?
plain_language.what_we_learned: Productive pruning preserves the full infinite language. On any fixed infinite retained set, finite parent-label deficiency exactly characterizes deletion-only repair, with a canonical maximal retained-edge relation.
plain_language.what_it_lets_someone_do: Choose the appropriate operation knowing whether it preserves every infinite realization or only avoidance, and whether connectivity or species properties require extra premises.
plain_language.what_cannot_conclude: Boundary repair need not preserve all word realizations, connectivity or species properties, and its optimization keeps the retained vertex set fixed.

exact_statement_and_scope: For an actual BinaryNatPopulation, productive pruning retains exactly vertices with infinitely many strict descendants. Finite roots, finite children and strict natural chronology yield an infinite ancestrally closed core, a constructed birth-order reindexing into the original eligible model, preservation of any supplied child cap and equivalence of the full infinite Boolean-word language. Whole-graph IAP is required only for the additional whole-core inspecies/specieslike conclusion; IAP means each member has finitely many descendants or finitely many non-descendants in the stated set. Unrestricted maximal connected-IAP-convex clusters are descendant-closed and pruning commutes; common-ancestor/reflection-constrained maximality need not imply descendant closure, although convexity plus reflection still makes pruning commute. Separately, for any fixed infinite retained S, finite incoming-label deficiency is equivalent to existence of an eligible deletion-only repair on exactly S. Deleting all remaining incoming edges at deficient vertices gives the greatest permissible retained-edge relation and inclusion-smallest deleted-edge/root sets, with all deleted edges below a finite birth bound. The reindexed repair preserves eligibility, a supplied child cap and every avoided target, not full language equivalence. The actual P_s C0 repair disconnects; C1 has the shifted original unlabelled geometry.
prior_work: Original simultaneous model/transport theorems using classical pruning and finite-union arguments; Alexander's species predicates and existing shared-root two-ray counterexample remain credited. The deletion criterion is a direct structural deduction, not a worldwide novelty claim.
our_contribution: The original Samuel package proves simultaneous eligibility, reindexing and exact infinite-language preservation for the productive core, separates two maximality predicates, and characterizes the canonical deletion-only repair. The stronger pruning equivalence is not silently assigned to repair.
